turns.instruction:
Analyze a continuous beam with 5 m and 7 m spans, a left pin and vertical rollers at x=5 and 12 m. Apply 16 kN/m downward only to the first span. Keep all members and restraints of the unloaded second span. Report all three support reactions, midpoint Z displacements at x=2.5 and 8.5 m, and the middle-support bending moment. Explain the response of the span without external loading.

Execute OpenSees; complete every output in input.md and check equilibrium. Clarify essential gaps or conflicts first.
